title: The supported boundary equation with the canonical residue Cartier endpoint
statement: For prime l, a scheme Y with its diagonal derived localizations, invertibility hY, ordinary strict reduction D, root system H, source limit isomorphism s, arbitrary Chern data c, restriction r, coefficient cones k, root comparison e, derived Ext presentation p and derived-limit models L₀,L, n≥0 and normalized finite frame a, define supportedFiniteBoundaryCartierEquation to be supportedBoundaryEquation [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-supported-boundary-equation] for the completed supported unit [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-completed-supported-unit], supported source comparison [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-supported-source-comparison], p.arrow and coefficientRootTransport [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficient-root-transport], with endpoint a.cartierMap(L,cartierResidueReducedPro at exponent n+1) [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-supported-finite-boundary-cartier-map]. This names a composite equation and asserts no normalization or existence; all source and Chern proof hypotheses are absent from this definition.
